products.title: Hill Country Heirloom 6 Fat Quarter Bundle – FWFS Exclusive
products.body_html:
Hill Country Heirloom carries the charm of an old-money Fredericksburg boutique — collected, graceful, and quietly refined. Soft aquas, weathered taupes, vintage florals, and elegant neutrals come together in a bundle that feels timeless and beautifully considered.

Hand-selected by FWFS and available exclusively through our shop, these fabrics were chosen to work beautifully together while still letting each print have its own moment to shine.

Limited quantities — once these heirloom beauties drift beyond the Hill Country, they’re gone.

Included:

  1. Sandalwood Camellia Florals Eucalptus
  2. Foraged, Found, & Hand Me Down Small Florals Mushroom
  3. Grunge Basics Mint
  4. Paper Hamlet Text & Words Paper
  5. The Trellis Palette Tonal Strawberry Thief Kelmscott Water
  6. Sandalwood Camellia Florals Opal

products.title: Juice Box Electric – FWFS Exclusive 8 Piece Fat Quarter Bundle
products.body_html:
Well, somebody plugged in the juice box, and things got a whole lot brighter! Juice Box Electric brings the same fun-loving attitude as our original Juice Box Energy, but this time we're turning up the voltage with electric blues, punchy lime greens, and prints that aren't the least bit shy. It's bold, a little wild, and definitely not for anyone looking to play it safe with their fabric choices. And y'all, we're perfectly fine with that.

Hand-selected by FWFS and available exclusively through our shop, these fabrics were chosen to work beautifully together while still letting each print have its own moment to shine.

Limited quantities—better grab yours before somebody pulls the plug!

Included:

  1. Radiant Poppies Sky
  2. Scenery Puffball Lime
  3. Radiant Leaves Midnight
  4. Canvas Texture Chartreuse
  5. Radiant Geometrics Sky
  6. Radiant Leaves Grass
  7. Spotted Graffiti Blue Hour
  8. Grunge Basics Key Lime
